crossTaskFindings.finding: Frozen protected() misses root test.js and index.test-d.ts. Native suites can be weakened by actor changes that are replayed, although independent private acceptance is always overlaid.
crossTaskFindings.recommendation: Keep frozen grades unchanged; inspect actual changed paths after unblinding. Do not claim complete original-test preservation without that review.

crossTaskFindings.finding: Mocha grading requires exact4 failure names/exit4 and nonzero tests, not equal total test/pass counts or same failure messages. Protected test/ source helps, but changed configs could reduce discovery, and fixing a previously known failure could be rejected.
crossTaskFindings.recommendation: Compare evaluated test counts/messages on completed attempts; do not treat expected nonzero native exit as full-suite success.
